product.name: Aurelio NovaKey 61
product.description: The Aurelio NovaKey 61 is a versatile digital keyboard designed for musicians of all levels. With 61 full‑size weighted keys, the instrument offers a responsive touch that mimics acoustic piano feel. Integrated MIDI and USB‑C outputs allow direct connection to computers and recording gear, while the onboard 128‑note polyphony supports complex arrangements. A backlit keybed and adjustable touch sensitivity provide a comfortable playing experience in any lighting. The NovaKey includes a built‑in metronome, arpeggiator, and a selection of 200 instrument sounds ranging from grand piano to synth pads. Its compact footprint and lightweight chassis make it ideal for studio, classroom, or travel use.
